sn55.10:1.1: nisinno kho āyasmā Ānando Bhagavantam etad avoca || ||
sn55.10:1.2: Kakkaṭo nāma bhante Ñātike upāsako kālakato
sn55.10:1.10: Subhaddo nāma bhante Ñātike upāsake kālakato
sn55.10:1.11: tassa kā gati ko abhisamparāyo ti || || 3.
sn55.10:2.1: Kakkaṭo Ānanda upāsako kālakato pañcannam orambhāgiyānaṃ saṃyojanānam parikkhayā opapātiko tattha parinibbāyī anāvattidhammo tasmā lokā ||
sn55.10:2.8: Subhaddo Ānanda upāsako kālakato pañcannam orambhāgiyānaṃ saṃyojanānam parikkhayā opapātiko tattha parinibbāyī anāvattidhammo tasmā lokā ||
sn55.10:3.1: Paropaññāsa Ānanda Ñātike upāsakā kālakatā pañcannam orambhāgiyānaṃ samyojanāṇam parikkhayā opapātikā tattha parinibbāyino anāvattidhammā tasmā lokā || ||
sn55.10:3.2: Sādhikanavuti Ānanda Ñātike upāsakā kālakatā tiṇṇaṃ saṃyojanānam parikkhayā rāgadosamohānaṃ tanuttā sakadāgāmino sakid eva imaṃ lokam āgantvā dukkhassantaṃ karissanti || ||
sn55.10:3.3: Cha atirekāni kho Ānanda pañcasatāni Ñātike upāsakā kālakatā tiṇṇaṃ saṃyojanānam parikkhayā sotāpannā avinipātadhammā niyatā sambodhiparāyanā || || 5.
sn55.10:4.1: Anacchariyaṃ kho panetam Ānanda yam manussabhūto kālaṃ kareyya || ||
sn55.10:4.2: Tasmiṃ tasmiṃ ce maṃ kālakate upasaṅkamitvā etam attham paṭipucchissatha || vihesā hesā Ānanda assa Tathāgatassa ||
sn55.10:4.3: tasmā ti hānanda dhammādāsaṃ nāma dhammapariyāyaṃ desissāmi || yena samannāgato ariyasāvako ākaṅkhamāno attanā va attānam vyākareyya ||
sn55.10:4.4: Khīṇanirayo mhi || khīṇatiracchānayoniko khīnapittivisayo khīnāpāyaduggativinipāto || sotāpanno ham asmi avinipātadhammo niyato sambodhiparāyano || || 6.
sn55.10:5.1: Katamo ca so Ānanda dhammādāso dhammapariyāyo yena samannāgato ariyasāvako ākaṅkhamāno attanā va attānaṃ vyākareyya ||
sn55.10:6.1: Idhānanda ariyasāvako Buddhe aveccappasādena samannāgato hoti || || Iti pi so Bhagavā || la-pe || satthā devamanussānam buddho bhagavā ti ||
sn55.10:6.4: Ariyakantehi sīlehi samannāgato hoti akhaṇḍehi || la-pe || samādhisaṃvattanikehi || || 7.
sn55.10:6.5: Ayaṃ kho so Ānanda dhammādāso dhammapariyāyo
sn55.10:6.6: yena samannāgato ariyasāvako ākaṅkhamāno attanā va attānaṃ vyākareyya || ||
sn55.10:6.7: Khīṇanirayo mhi || khīṇatiracchānayoniko khīṇapittivisayo || khīnāpāyaduggativinipāto || sotāpanno ham asmi avinipātadhammo niyato sambodhiparāyano ti || ||
